description: Vector Bat Mobile App - High realism 3D batsman visualizer, Grok/Gemini AI shot prediction, and offline sensor management

userStories.title: Procedural PBR textures & realistic proportions for 3D Batsman
userStories.description: As a cricketer, I want realistic 3D visuals of the batsman and bat so the app feels like a professional coaching tool rather than a cartoon.
acceptanceCriteria: Batsman model uses canvas-generated PBR textures for willow bat, jersey, batting pads, and helmet
Renderer uses ACESFilmicToneMapping with realistic lighting and soft shadows
Bat blade is accurately sized (cricket standard proportions) with realistic grip and cone handle
userStories.notes: Implemented in LiveSwingVisualizer.tsx with Three.js r134 canvas PBR textures and bent-knee athletic stance.

userStories.title: Real-time AI Shot Prediction with Grok & Gemini APIs
userStories.description: As a user, I want instant AI feedback predicting the shot type and quality after each real swing.
acceptanceCriteria: AiShotPredictionService integrates Grok beta API with Gemini 1.5 Flash fallback
Local physics heuristic fallback runs if network or APIs fail
Live screen displays AI Coach prediction with provider badge (GROK / GEMINI)
userStories.notes: Created services/AiShotPredictionService.ts and wired into HardwareSensorService.ts and live.tsx.

userStories.title: Strict offline sensor mode without hardcoded mock data
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to show OFFLINE when the sensor is disconnected rather than showing synthetic swing data.
acceptanceCriteria: Live screen displays OFFLINE badge when hardware WebSocket is disconnected
Metrics show '--' or 0 instead of fake mock values when disconnected
Stream source defaults to 'hardware' by default
userStories.notes: Updated live.tsx to initialize lastSwing to null and show OFFLINE badge.

userStories.title: Fixed timestep animation loop (rAF) in LiveSwingVisualizer
userStories.description: As a user, I want ultra-smooth 60fps swing physics and impact interpolation regardless of device refresh rate.
acceptanceCriteria: Visualizer animate loop uses fixed-timestep physics updates (accumulator pattern at 60Hz)
Bat rotation smoothly interpolates sensor quaternion/Euler angles
userStories.notes: Refactored visualizer animate() loop into 60Hz fixed-timestep physicsStep(dt) accumulator pattern.

userStories.title: Post-impact trajectory trail and sweet spot impact indicator
userStories.description: As a cricketer, I want to see the 3D bat trajectory arc and a visual indicator where the ball struck the bat face.
acceptanceCriteria: Render 3D ribbon/line trail tracing the bat sweet spot during the swing
Show a glowing impact spot on the bat face where impact was registered
Trail automatically fades after swing resets
